fullStrategyPairedRaces.explanation: Attacks are independent of opponent attacks. Fixed fleets and alternating turns make outcomes exactly determined by shots-to-sink; first player wins equal-shot races. Every seed is evaluated in both first-player roles. Normal uses selected mixed layouts; Easy uses spaced layouts; HuntTarget uses random layouts.

limitations: Single-shell turns only; no multi-shell strength claim. Placement rule is recorded explicitly.
